searchText: EOF call today? yes https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/85004720429?pwd=K1hnV1Z4bE1RZW50VEZTQnlCNHNuUT09 As mentioned on the call, here's the test that shold cover all of the opcodes that would be impacted by address space expansion - https://github.com/ethereum/tests/blob/f91d64ad2493acb2d2322c7a9f7853af7b8847a8/src/GeneralStateTestsFiller/stBadOpcode/invalidAddrFiller.yml We mostly touch or remove most of them in EOF. Exception seems to be `BALANCE`. Although these do not include instructions returning addresses, but these are less problematic. We could handle extended address as if the account does not exist (seems better to revert because reverting would need to be changed if ASE is actually implemented). But they are funny quirks, e.g. you burn ETH with this. **EOF Implementers Call 22** https://youtu.be/LA5je8UGrkk
